highlights: The Green Lion Cardio Band Chest Strap offers precise heart rate and HRV monitoring for those serious about fitness.
Its advanced ECG sensor captures accurate data during any activity.
Made with soft nylon, it stays comfortable all day, while the acrylic and PC body ensures durability.
The strap adjusts between 65 and 100 cm and weighs just 80 grams, making it easy to wear during workouts or daily use.
Compatible with devices using Bluetooth V5.0 and ANT+, it works with most fitness gear and apps.
You’ll recharge it quickly in 1.5 hours thanks to its magnetic charging port, and get up to 30 hours of battery life. The IP67 rating means it’s protected against sweat and splashes.
